description: Every sword, axe, pickaxe, shovel, hoe and other melee tool or weapon on this pack (1150 items: an item whose class extends ItemSword, ItemTool or ItemHoe, a Spartan weapon, any item with a tool class, or a registry name ending in _sword, _axe, _pickaxe, _shovel or _hoe; armour, bows, quivers, buckets, parachutes, baubles and item blocks left out), for weaponStats. attackDamage / attackSpeed: the main-hand attribute totals (1 + the damage modifier, 4 + the speed modifier) after Material Changer, null where the code or config that sets them was not read; cooldownTicks: vanilla's 20 / attackSpeed. bc*: Better Combat's packet (playerAttack.betterCombatPacket in combat.json). Generated by tools/build-weapons.mjs from the class files of every jar in the pinned pack zip (superclass chains, which classes override getItemAttributeModifiers or write the tool fields) and its configs; the families read from bytecode are in source: vanilla, pyrotech, spartan (fixtures/weapons-3.3.4/).

sources.vanilla: minecraft:{wooden,stone,iron,golden,diamond}_{sword,axe,pickaxe,shovel,hoe}: Item$ToolMaterial damage WOOD 0, STONE 1, IRON 2, DIAMOND 3, GOLD 0; ItemSword 3 + material, -2.4; ItemAxe(material) its arrays f/n; ItemPickaxe 1 + material, -2.8; ItemSpade 1.5 + material, -3.0; ItemHoe damage modifier 0, speed field material + 1 (modifier field - 4); then Material Changer
sources.pyrotech: pyrotech tools: ItemInitializer (bone, flint: athenaeum ModuleMaterials 1.0; obsidian 2.0; axes ItemAxe(material, 8, -3.2), obsidian -3.0), crude tools vanilla STONE (ItemAxe(STONE) arrays), redstone and quartz ModuleCore$Materials 1.0 with axes (8, -2.8), hammers ItemTool(material, blocks) = damage material, speed field 0 (attack speed 4); then Material Changer
sources.spartan: spartanweaponry: ItemSwordBase / ItemThrowingWeapon set the damage field to max(0.5, base + multiplier x material - 1) and the speed to the type's speed (melee speed for throwing weapons), all from spartanweaponry.cfg; material damage: vanilla materials' (wood 0, stone 1, iron 2, gold 0, diamond 3), modded ones its damageBase<Metal>; ItemBoomerang has no modifiers; Material Changer reaches it (getItemAttributeModifiers reads ItemSword.attackDamage)
sources.spartan-addon: spartanfire, spartancompat, spartantwilight: Spartan's own weapon classes and type config (speed), with the add-on's materials (damage not read unless Material Changer sets it)
sources.vanilla-class: a class that inherits the vanilla modifiers and does not write the tool fields: ItemSword speed 1.6, ItemPickaxe 1.2, ItemSpade 1.0, ItemHoe damage 1, a plain Item no modifiers (1, speed 4); the rest comes from its material or constructor (not read) unless Material Changer sets it
sources.materialchanger: only Material Changer's ATTACK_DAMAGE / ATTACK_SPEED settles the number

qualityTools: Quality Tools defines only baubles qualities on this pack (config/qualitytools/Quailities/baubles.json): no tool or weapon carries quality modifiers
